description:
The Sale Order Excel Report module allows users to generate Excel reports for selected sale orders in an easy-to-read and visually appealing format. With this module, you can download and maintain all sale order data in a single file, making sales management and analysis more efficient.
Features
Generate separate sheets for each sale order in the Excel file.
Easily maintain all sale order data in one organized Excel file.
Access a menu option to download Excel reports for selected sale orders.
Benefits
Quickly access detailed sale order data in Excel format.
Keep your sale order records organized with a clean and structured design.
Manage and analyze multiple sale orders efficiently in one place.
How to Download Sale Order Excel Report
Go to Sales → Orders → Quotations/Orders
Click on the Action dropdown.
Select “Sale Order Excel Report” to download the Excel report for the selected sale orders.
Multi Sale Order Excel Report
Open any sale order.
Click on the Action button.
Select “Sale Order Excel Report” to download the report for the currently opened sale order.

name: Woocommerce Integration
description:
The Odoo Woocommerce Connector facilitates the seamless integration of Odoo with Woocommerce, making day-to-day operations easier for warehouse and sales teams through automation.
        This module streamlines workflows by allowing businesses to synchronize products, sale orders, and customer data between Odoo and Woocommerce. 

        Key Features:
        - Multi Instance Support: Manage multiple Woocommerce stores from a single Odoo instance.
        - Synchronize Products: Automatically sync product data between Woocommerce and Odoo for real-time inventory updates.
        - Synchronize Sale Orders: Seamlessly sync sale orders from Woocommerce to Odoo for efficient order processing.
        - Synchronize Customer Data: Sync customer details, including contact information, from Woocommerce to Odoo.
        - Dashboard: Centralized interface to manage all synchronization activities.
        - Instance Creation: Configure multiple Woocommerce instances within Odoo using API details.
        - Product and Status Configuration: Easily configure product backorders, product visibility, and tax status.
        - Product Export: Export selected products to the middle layer for further processing.
        - Detailed Product Views: Access detailed views of products, variants, and other product details in the middle layer.
        - Bulk Import/Export: Simplify bulk import and export of categories, attributes, and orders across both platforms.
        - Synchronization History: Track and view synchronization activities to monitor data exchange between Odoo and Woocommerce.

        This app is ideal for businesses using Woocommerce for eCommerce and looking to integrate it with Odoo for better inventory and order management, customer handling, and streamlined operations. With seamless synchronization between Odoo and Woocommerce, users can ensure that their eCommerce operations are more efficient and up-to-date.
